g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS lift-and-shift of a Windows three-tier application with Application Migration Service

g.title: None.None.Node.36
g.text: The Application Migration Service agent on each server replicates its disks continuously
to the VPC's virtual private gateway
and a replication server in the staging subnet, which keeps the copies on EBS
At cutover, MGN launches the web and app tiers as EC2 instances in their Auto Scaling groups
Customers reach the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
which sends them to the IIS web tier
The web tier calls the application tier through an internal load balancer
which uses Multi-AZ RDS for SQL Server
and the file shares moved to FSx for Windows File Server, joined to AWS Managed Microsoft AD
The SSM agent on each instance reaches Systems Manager through interface endpoints
and a maintenance window applies the Windows patch baseline
AWS Backup protects the database and the file shares
